## Credited conditional prior applicability

Add the complete accepted applicability certificate for **30006105 / OWR-14298804-007**, also covering duplicate **30006106 / OWR-14298804-008**. This records an existing result, with **zero new substantive proof-search turns** and no historical accounting reset.

Credit **Vincent Froese, Moritz Grillo, Christoph Hertrich, and Moritz Stargalla**, *Parameterized Hardness of Zonotope Containment and Neural Network Verification*, [arXiv:2509.22849v3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.22849v3), 3 September 2026, Section 6, Theorem 6.1, p.20. The expanded v3 extends a preliminary [ICLR 2026 conference publication](https://proceedings.iclr.cc/paper_files/paper/2026/hash/4db5ca5ff61529e9bebe2089bf466ca8-Abstract-Conference.html); separate journal review of v3 is not verified.

For exact binary-rational generator input with total binary length N, non-containment is W[1]-hard in dimension d and containment is co-W[1]-hard. Consequently deterministic dimension-FPT containment would imply FPT=W[1]. Under ETH, neither exact decision direction has a deterministic rho(d) N^o(d) algorithm. The conclusion is conditional and model-specific: no unconditional complexity separation, unrestricted real-RAM lower bound, approximation hardness or completeness claim.

## Full mathematical scope retained

The [OWR 50/2024 question](https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/50767), printed pp.2988–2989, uses the same generator convention Z(A)=sum_i[0,a_i]. The certificate retains the exact support-function proof in both directions, strict witness threshold, sign and coefficient handling, and the caveat against independent recentering.

The reconstructed prior reduction retains the triangle-gadget correctness, explicit integer generator columns, all positive/zero/negative homogenizing-coordinate cases, equal centers and full-dimensionality, dimension d=k+1, O(log(q+1)) entry bit-length and N=O(q^3 log(q+1)), with all external Multicolored Clique and Sidon-set dependencies stated. Complement closure transfers the prior's non-containment theorem to containment.

The v3 p.11 rising piecewise branch prints minus 1/4; plus 1/4 is required and is already present in the displayed ReLU implementation. The certificate preserves this nonblocking local typo correction and follows the correct implementation.

The complete substantive mathematical text and all limits and attribution are byte-preserved. Finite-computation material and repository/workflow history are omitted, without converting excluded artifacts to prose. A scoped acceptance binds the actual certificate edition; it does not invent a new independent audit. Public metadata records the identities of two public PDFs and their original retrieval, inspection and status history, without distributing source text or documents.

AI-assisted and unrefereed; no novelty, independent discovery, external human peer review, proof-assistant certification or exhaustive current-literature certification is claimed.

## Repository boundary and preparation

Exactly seven files are added under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30006105/`. The duplicate is identified in the canonical report. No QUEUE.md, existing attempt, unrelated record or historical turn count is changed. No merge, release, DOI deposit or external outreach is included.

The packet contains authored mathematical audit, scoped acceptance and public bibliographic verification metadata only. Source bodies, datasets, private material, scripts, fixtures, computation outputs and logs, and excluded-artifact identities are omitted. No excluded material is converted to replacement prose.

The editorial delta, preserved mathematical prefix, original manifests, public PDF identities, UTF-8/JSON, relative links, manifest, exact allowlist and exclusion scan were checked. The additive patch passed strict-whitespace clean temporary replay with exact paths and bytes. Fresh complete base trees and the expected changed tree chain were rehashed independently and cross-checked with Git; every unrelated entry, including QUEUE.md, remains unchanged. These are packaging checks, not additional mathematical certification. No CI or exact-head remote readback pass is claimed.

Base: `f6caddda8f8be2cdb3e91494325d8f7f365bc3fc`.
